svg.title: ARC-500 Door & Window Schedule
svg.text: 95 OPENINGS · 24 TYPES · MEASURED FROM THE PLANS
1. Measured from the plans, not compiled beside them. Every
opening is a pair of coordinates the plan cuts its wall
with and the elevation draws its frame in, so this
schedule and those drawings cannot disagree about a width.
2. Marks run largest first within each kind, so D01 is the
widest door and W01 the widest window. L marks are the
west wall's louvres: that face is blind below the
3. Heads and sills are constant through the building — sill
+0.90, head +2.40 — so a type is distinguished by its
width alone except at the doors.
ironmongery and finishes are not set by the geometry and
are not invented here. They belong to ARC-600 and the
5. Dimensions are structural opening sizes. Frame and
tolerance allowances to be taken off by the supplier
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P17 2026-10-07 ARC-000 deliverables list; title corrected to five storeys
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
